title: AI ‘godfather’ Yann LeCun has ‘zero concerns’ about human extinction, says Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is ‘deluded’
summary: Yann LeCun, a Turing Award-winning AI pioneer, dismisses concerns about human extinction from AI, calling Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 'deluded' for his warnings. LeCun argues AI risk narratives are overblown and distract from real issues, reflecting an ongoing public debate between AI safety advocates and skeptics about existential risk.
